title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Bulevar umetnosti

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 25.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until July 25, 2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u Bulevaru umetnosti,  na potezu od Bulevara Mihajla Pupina do Bulevara Zorana Đinđića - desna kolovozna traka  u smeru ka Bulevaru Zorana Đinđića i raskrsnica ulica Bulevar umetnosti - Bulevar Zorana Đinđića, u periodu od 08.07. do 09.07.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Boulevard of the Arts, on the stretch from Boulevard Mihajlo Pupin to Boulevard Zoran Đinđić - the right lane in the direction of Boulevard Zoran Đinđić and the intersection of Boulevard of the Arts - Boulevard Zorana Đinđić, in the period from 08.07. until 07/09/2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju potpuno zauzeće kolovoza desne kolovozne trake u Bulevaru umetnosti na datom potezu pri čemu će i raskrsnica sa Bulevarom Zorana Đinđića biti neprohodna za saobraćaj, pri čemu će traka za desno skretanje iz Bulevara umetnosti ka Bulevaru Zorana Đinđića (smer ka gradu) i trake za skretanje udesno iz Bulevara Zorana Đinđića ka Bulevaru umetnosti (u oba smera) biti prohodne. Tokom izvođenja radova doći će do izmena u radu na linijama javnog prevoza koje će saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: The works involve the complete occupation of the roadway of the right lane in the Boulevard of the Arts on the given stretch, whereby the intersection with the Boulevard of Zoran Đinđić will be impassable to traffic, whereby the lane for turning right from the Boulevard of the Arts to the Boulevard of Zoran Đinđić (direction towards the city) and the lanes for turning right from the Boulevard of Zoran Đinđić to the Boulevard of the Arts (in both directions) will be passable. During the execution of the works, there will be changes in the operation of the public transport lines, which will run as follows:

sections.text: Vozila će na izmenjenom delu trase koristiti postojeća kao i privremeno stajalište „Španskih boraca 1“ ulici Španskih boraca, 145 metara posle zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Bulevar Zorana Đinđića, gledano u smeru ka ulici Bulevar Mihajla Pupina.

text_translations.en: Vehicles on the changed part of the route will use the existing as well as the temporary stop "Španskih boraca 1" on Španskih boraca Street, 145 meters after the intersection zone with Bulevar Zorana Đinđića Street, seen in the direction of Bulevar Mihajlo Pupina Street.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Bulevar umetnosti Street

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Nedeljka Gvozdenovića

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 15.08.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until August 15, 2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na izgradnji kišne i fekalne kanalizacije u ulici Nedeljka Gvozdenovića, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Surčinska do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Srđana Aleksića doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the construction of rain and fecal sewage in Nedeljka Gvozdenovića Street, in the part from the intersection with Surčinska Street to the intersection with Srđana Aleksić Street, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines. The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza Ia - Radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju zatvaranje kolovoza ulice Nedeljka Gvozdenovića, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Srđana Aleksića narednih oko 60 metara prema ulici Surčinska u periodu od 07.07. do 25.07.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi, za saobraćaj će biti zatvorena ulica Nedeljka Gvozdenovića na posmatranoj deonici, kao sama raskrsnica sa ulicom Srđana Aleksića, na taj način da će biti onemogućen izlazak vozila javnog prevoza iz okretnice „Bežanijska kosa“.

text_translations.en: Phase Ia - Works in this phase include the closure of the roadway of Nedeljko Gvozdenovića Street, on the part of the intersection zone with Srđana Aleksića Street, for the next 60 meters towards Surčinska Street, in the period from 07.07. until 25.07.2026. year. During the execution of the works in this phase, Nedeljko Gvozdenovića Street will be closed to traffic on the observed section, as well as the intersection with Srđana Aleksića Street, in such a way that it will be impossible for public transport vehicles to exit the "Bežanijska Kosa" roundabout.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi vozila javnog prevoza će saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in this phase, public transport vehicles will operate as follows:

sections.text: Faza Ib - Radovi se nadovezuju na radove iz prethodne faze i izvode se do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Surčinska u periodu od 26.07. do 15.08.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi, za saobraćaj će biti zatvorena ulica Nedeljka Gvozdenovića na posmatranoj deonici.

text_translations.en: Phase Ib - The works are a continuation of the works from the previous phase and are carried out to the area of ​​the intersection with Surčinska Street in the period from 26.07. until 15.08.2026. year. During the execution of works in this phase, Nedeljko Gvozdenovića Street will be closed to traffic on the observed section.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u ovoj fazi vozila javnog prevoza će saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in this phase, public transport vehicles will operate as follows:

sections.text:
• vozila sa linije br. 72 će u oba smera saobraćati ulicama Tošin bunar, Vojvođanska, Surčinska i dalje redovnom trasom;
• vozila sa linije br. 72N  će u oba smera saobraćati ulicama Bulevar Zorana Đinđića, Žorža Matea, Partizanske avijacije, Marka Čelebonovića, Dr Huga Klajna, Ljubinke Bobić, Gandijeva, Vojvođanska, Surčinska i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en:
• vehicles from line no. 72 will run in both directions on the streets Tošin bunar, Vojvođanska, Surčinska and further along the regular route;
• vehicles from line no. 72N will run in both directions on Bulevar Zoran Đinđić, Žorž Mateo, Partizanska avijacija, Marko Čelebonović, Dr. Hugo Klajn, Ljubinka Bobić, Gandijeva, Vojvođanska, Surčinska streets and further along the regular route.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Braće Jerković - Faza 2

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na izgradnji distributivne toplovodne mreže u ulici Braće Jerković - Faza 2, u periodu od 01.07. do 15.07.2026. godine, doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the construction of the distribution hot water network in Braće Jerković Street - Phase 2, in the period from 01.07. until 15.07.2026. year, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode u desnoj saobraćajnoj traci u ulici Braće Jerković (gledano u smeru ka ulici Darvinova) na delu od kućnog broja 123D do kućnog broja 123A (u visini stajališta „SC Sport eko“). Tokom izvođenja radova biće zauzeta desna saobraćajna traka i samo stajalište (gledano u smeru ka ulici Darvinova). Zbog nedovoljne širine preostalog dela kolovoza, doći će do promene u radu linija JLPP-a i to:

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out in the right traffic lane on Braće Jerković Street (seen in the direction of Darvinova Street) in the section from house number 123D to house number 123A (at the height of the "SC Sport eko" stop). During the execution of the works, the right traffic lane and the stop itself (seen in the direction of Darvinova Street) will be occupied. Due to the insufficient width of the remaining part of the roadway, there will be a change in the operation of the JLPP lines, namely:

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 18, 18N i ADA3 će u smeru ka Zemunu, saobraćati ulicama Svetozara Radojčića, Dragice Končar, Zaplanjska, Darvinova, Kumodraška i dalje redovnim trasama, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnim trasama;

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 18, 18N and ADA3 in the direction of Zemun will travel on the streets of Svetozar Radojčić, Dragica Končar, Zaplanjska, Darvinova, Kumodraška and further on regular routes, while in the opposite direction they will travel on regular routes;

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 50 i 80 će u smeru ka Čukarici, saobraćati ulicama Svetozara Radojčića, Dragice Končar, Zaplanjska, Darvinova, Braće Jerković, Kružni put Voždovački i dalje redovnim trasama, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 50 and 80 in the direction of Čukarica, will run on the streets of Svetozar Radojčić, Dragica Končar, Zaplanjska, Darvinova, Braće Jerković, Kružni put Voždovački and continue on regular routes, while in the opposite direction they will run on regular routes.

sections.text: Vozila će na izmenjenim delovima trasa koristiti postojeća, kao i privremeno stajalište „Braće Jerković 1“ u ulici Darvinova, ispred objekta sa kućnim brojem 19, odnosno 30 metara ispred zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Braće Jerković.

text_translations.en: Vehicles on the changed sections of the route will use the existing, as well as the temporary stop "Braće Jerković 1" in Darvinova Street, in front of the building with house number 19, i.e. 30 meters in front of the intersection zone with Braće Jerković Street.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Braće Jerković Street - Phase 2

title: Informacija o promeni režima radalinija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Dunavska

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Dunavska, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Tadeuša Košćuškog do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Dubrovačka u periodu od 01.07. godine do 31.07.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works on Dunavska Street, on the part from the intersection zone with Tadeuša Košćuški Street to the intersection zone with Dubrovačka Street in the period from 01.07. until 31.07.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zatvaranje za saobraćaj dela desne saobraćajne trake i trotoara na posmatranoj deonici (gledano u smeru ka ulici Dubrovačka), pri čemu će se preostala širina kolovoza koristiti za dvosmerno odvijanje saobraćaja.

text_translations.en: The works involve the closure of part of the right traffic lane and the sidewalk on the observed section (seen in the direction of Dubrovačka Street), whereby the remaining width of the roadway will be used for two-way traffic.

sections.text: Predmetni radovi neće uticati na funkcionisanje linija javnog prevoza. Vozila sa linija br. 26, 26N i 401n će umesto polazno/dolaznog stajališta#2110 „Dorćol (Dunavska)“ koristiti privremeno polazno/dolazno stajalište „Dorćol (Dunavska) 1“, koje se nalazi u ulici Dubrovačka, na poziciji niše za parkiranje, neposredno ispred zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Mike Alasa, koja će se u ovom slučaju koristiti kao stajalište javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: The subject works will not affect the functioning of public transport lines. Vehicles from lines no. 26, 26N and 401n, instead of departure/arrival stop #2110 "Dorćol (Dunavska)", will use the temporary departure/arrival stop "Dorćol (Dunavska) 1", which is located on Dubrovačka Street, in the position of the parking niche, immediately in front of the intersection with Mike Alasa Street, which in this case will be used as a public transport stop.

title_translations.en: Information about the change of mode of public transport lines during the execution of works in Dunavska Street

title: Informacija o radovima u ulici Vojvođanska /deonica 2/ - Faza 1

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja Faze 1 radova na asfaltiranju i uređenju Ulice Vojvođanska (GO Surčin), na deonici od Ulice Aerodrom Beograd do Ulice Niška, u periodu od 06.07. do 17.07.2026. godine, doći će do izmena u funkcionisanju javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of Phase 1 of works on asphalting and landscaping of Vojvođanska Street (GO Surčin), on the section from Aerodrom Beograd Street to Niška Street, in the period from 06.07. until 17.07.2026. year, there will be changes in the functioning of public transport.

sections.text: U okviru radova na kolovozu u Ulici Vojvođanska, na deonici od Ulice Aerodrom Beograd do Ulice Hajduk Veljkova, doći će do zauzeća središnjeg dela kolovoza u oba smera. Navedeni radovi neće uticati na trasu kretanja vozila JLPP-a u zoni radova, jer će saobraćaj biti omogućen na preostaloj slobodnoj saobraćajnoj traci po smeru.

text_translations.en: As part of the works on the roadway in Vojvođanska Street, on the section from Aerodrom Beograd Street to Hajduk Veljkova Street, the central part of the roadway will be occupied in both directions. The aforementioned works will not affect the movement of JLPP vehicles in the work zone, as traffic will be enabled on the remaining free traffic lane in the direction.

sections.text: Istovremeno će se izvoditi radovi na kolovozu (leva saobraćajna traka, gledano u smeru ka gradu) i na trotoaru Ulice Vojvođanska, na deonici od Ulice Hajduk Veljkova do Ulice Niška. Vozila JLPP-a će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza, uz naizmenično propuštanje koje će biti regulisano privremenim semaforima i saobraćajnom signalizacijom.

text_translations.en: At the same time, works will be carried out on the roadway (left traffic lane, viewed in the direction of the city) and on the sidewalk of Vojvođanska Street, on the section from Hajduk Veljkova Street to Niška Street. JLPP vehicles will move in the work zone on the free width of the roadway, with alternating passing that will be regulated by temporary traffic lights and traffic signals.

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja radova u Fazi 1, privremeno se izmešta autobusko stajalište „Vikend naselje“ (smer ka gradu) u Ulici Vojvođanska, na privremenu lokaciju koja se nalazi oko 65 metara ispred raskrsnice sa Ulicom Petog oktobra, odnosno oko 98 metara ispred redovne pozicije stajališta.

text_translations.en: During the performance of works in Phase 1, the "Vikend naselje" bus stop (direction towards the city) in Vojvođanska Street is temporarily moved to a temporary location located about 65 meters before the intersection with Petog Oktobar Street, that is, about 98 meters before the regular stop.

Tokom izvođenja radova doći će do zauzeća desne kolovozne trake, gledano u smeru ka Topčiderskom parku, pri čemu će leva kolozna traka na deonici gde je zona radova biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj. Takođe, biće onemogućen pristup iz saobraćajnice koja se nalazi ispod nadvožnjaka Mosta na Adi ka saobraćajnici koja vodi prema ulici Teodora Drajzera, zbog čega će vozila sa linije br. 3A u smeru ka Kneževcu saobraćati ulicama Bulevar vojvode Mišića, ulaznom rampom ka velikom kružnom toku u nivou Mosta na Adi, zatim ponovo Bulevarom vojvode Mišića. U visini zone radova  vozila će preći u levu kolovoznu traku koja je dvosmerna za saobraćaj, a nakon približno 100 metara vratiće se u desnu kolovoznu traku u Bulevar vojvode Mišića i dalje nastaviti redovnom trasom ka Kneževcu, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the carriageway in Bulevar Vojvode Mišića Street, on the part from the position located about 230 meters in front of the intersection with the tram tracks, the next 190 meters in the direction of Topčiderski Park. During the execution of the works, the right carriageway will be occupied, seen in the direction of Topčiderski Park, while the left carriageway on the section where the work zone is will be two-way for traffic. Also, it will be impossible to access from the road that is located under the overpass of Mosta na Ada to the road that leads to Teodora Dreizer Street, which is why vehicles from line no. 3A in the direction of Kneževac, drive along Vojvode Mišić Boulevard, take the entrance ramp to the large roundabout at the level of the Bridge on Ada, then again on Vojvode Mišić Boulevard. At the height of the work zone, vehicles will move to the left lane, which is two-way for traffic, and after approximately 100 meters, they will return to the right lane in Vojvode Mišić Boulevard and continue on the regular route towards Kneževac, while they will drive in the opposite direction on the regular route.

text_translations.en: During the duration of this regime change, the "Careva ćuprija" stop in the direction of Kneževac will not function.

During the execution of the works, the right side of the sidewalk (seen in the direction of the city) will be occupied, and these works will not affect the functioning of the JLPP;

title: Informacija o promeni režima saobraćaja i režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na uklanjanju Starog savskog mosta

sections.text:
• Tramvajske linije br. 7 i 9 će u oba smera, od zone Savskog trga saobraćati ulicama Savska, Bulevar vojvode Mišića, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Adi, Bulevar heroja sa Košara, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Antifašističke borbe i dalje redovno do Bloka 45 i nosiće oznake 7L i 9L.
• Uspostavlja se privremena autobuska linija br. 9A (Trg Slavija - Blok 45)  koja će u intervalu od 12  minuta pokrivati deo trase kojim neće ići tramvaji (Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Milentija Popovića i Sajmište) i trasa linije 9A biće: Trg Slavija, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov most, privremena devijacija na ulicu Ušće, Ušće (Bulevar Mihajla Pupina u smeru ka gradu), Sajmište, Zemunski put, tramvajskom bašticom do ulice Milentija Popovića i dalje redovno trasama tramvajskih linija do Bloka 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 i 83 su počev od 04. oktobra zbog izvođenja pripremnih radova i oštećenja na Starom savskom mostu preusmerene na trasu Brankovim mostom i saobraćaju ulicama: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa (Admirala Geprata u smeru ka Banjici odnosno Crvenom krstu), Pop Lukina, Brankov most, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje redovno do Zemuna. 
• Vozila će na izmenjenim delovima trasa koristiti postojeća kao i novouspostavljena privremena stajališta „Kamenička 1“ i „Brankov most 1“ za linije br. 9A, 78 i 83 - smer prema Trgu Slavija, odnosno „Staro sajmište“ - smer prema Bloku 45 za liniju br. 9A.

text_translations.en:
• Tram lines no. 7 and 9 will run in both directions, from the area of ​​Sava Square, through the streets of Savska, Bulevar Vojvode Mišić, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Ada, Bulevar Herojas sa Košar, Bulevar Crvena Armija, Bulevar Milutin Milankovića, Bulevar Antifascistke Borbe and continue regularly to Block 45 and will carry signs 7L and 9L.
• A temporary bus line no. 9A (Trg Slavija - Block 45), which will cover the part of the route on which trams will not run (Milutin Milanković Boulevard, Milentija Popovića and Sajmište) and the route of line 9A will be: Slavija Square, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, temporary deviation to Ušće Street, Ušće (Mihajla Pupina Boulevard in the direction of the city), Sajmište, Zemunski put, by tram garden to Milentija Popovića Street and further by regular tram routes to Block 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 and 83 have been diverted since October 4 due to preparatory works and damage to the Old Sava Bridge to the Brankov Most route and traffic on the streets: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrilo Principa (Admiral Geprato in the direction of Banjica, i.e. the Red Cross), Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and further regularly to Zemun. 
• Vehicles will use the existing as well as the newly established temporary stops "Kamenička 1" and "Brankov most 1" for lines no. 9A, 78 and 83 - direction towards Trg Slavija, i.e. "Staro sajmište" - direction towards Block 45 for line no. 9A.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the traffic regime and the mode of operation of public transport lines during the works on the removal of the Old Sava Bridge

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulicama Svetog Joakima i Ane u naselju Međulužje (GO Mladenovac)

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza br. 860U zbog oštećenja mosta iznad kanala u ulici gola bara u naselju Ušće - Opština Obrenovac

sections.text: Radovi su produženi do 31.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works have been extended until July 31, 2026. year.

sections.text: Na osnovu Rešenja Sekretarijata za saobraćaj o tehničkom regulisanju saobraćaja, a prema tehničkoj dokumentaciji ''Posebna organizacija saobraćaja u zoni mosta ID 364 preko kanala u ulici Gola Bara, MZ Ušće, opština Obrenovac'', izvršena je promena trasa  linija javnog prevoza br. 860U  u samom naselju Ušće zbog ograničenja kretanja vozila čija ukupna masa prelazi 3,5t.

text_translations.en: Based on the Decision of the Secretariat for Transport on the technical regulation of traffic, and according to the technical documentation "Special organization of traffic in the area of ​​the bridge ID 364 over the canal in Gola Bara street, MZ Ušće, Obrenovac municipality", the routes of public transport lines no. 860U in the Ušće settlement itself due to restrictions on the movement of vehicles whose total weight exceeds 3.5t.

sections.text: Tokom perioda trajanja ovog ograničenja, linije javnog prevoza br. 860U  će saobraćati na skraćenoj trasi do stare okretnice u naselju Ušće.

text_translations.en: During the duration of this restriction, public transport lines no. 860U will run on a shortened route to the old turnpike in the Ušće settlement.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase vozila će koristiti privremena stajališta u zonama istoimenih za suprotan smer.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, vehicles will use temporary stops in the zones of the same name for the opposite direction.
